title: Finite pushforward of a constructible module sheaf with finite geometric stalks
statement: Let Lambda be a commutative ring, X a Noetherian scheme, f:Y -> X a finite morphism, and F a sheaf of Lambda-modules on the small etale site of Y. Assume F is constructible in Scheme.IsConstructibleSheaf [def-constructible-constructible], and that every geometric stalk over a separably closed field is finite as a set [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Then f_*F [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is constructible as a Lambda-module sheaf. No Noetherian hypothesis on Lambda is assumed.

source.place: Constructibility of the middle term: finite abelian pushforward and finite-ring module refinement; generalized finite-stalk formulation by T2, using Stacks Tag 095R

proof.text: A finite morphism to the Noetherian target has Noetherian source: apply AlgebraicGeometry.isNoetherian_of_locallyOfFiniteType, with the finite-type and quasi-compact instances of the finite morphism. Define the ideal I explicitly as the intersection of all annihilators of source section modules. Apply finite_quotient_section_annihilator_of_finite_stalks to obtain that Lambda/I is finite.

Apply the proved isConstructibleEtaleSheafOfSets_of_finite_module_stalks to obtain constructible underlying source sets, with no coefficient-ring finiteness assumed. Forget F to an abelian sheaf E. Apply isConstructibleEtaleSheafOfSets_lowerStar_of_isNoetherian to f and E. Its conclusion is definitionally the underlying set sheaf of the module direct image.

Membership in I implies membership in each source section-module annihilator, hence sectionwise annihilation by Module.mem_annihilator. Direct image sections are definitionally source sections on the base-changed etale object, so I still kills them. Apply isConstructibleSheaf_of_finite_coefficient_underlying_sets to the direct image, its set constructibility, the canonical I and its finite quotient.

proof_origin.place: S2 Lean reduction: canonical annihilator quotient, proved underlying-set conversion, existing abelian finite pushforward, sectionwise annihilation, module reconstruction.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits concerning scheme constructible images and finite-type sheaves of modules, not this etale direct-image theorem. Loogle IsConstructibleSheaf is unknown.

Mathlib search gave zero hits. Project has the finite abelian underlying-set theorem, finite-etale locally constant module pushforward, and closed immersion module pushforward; none covers finite non-etale morphisms with arbitrary coefficient ring. Blueprint lem-fin-finite-morphism also gives higher direct image vanishing and assumes a finite-type field base; it has no Lean declaration.
